evidence.context_excerpt: Cough is a common pulmonary actinomycosis symptom.
Cough is a common manifestation of adenovirus pneumonia.
Cough was recorded in 2/48 typical and 2/13 atypical registry cases with available data.

Persistent cough, often productive, is the commonest symptom of chronic pulmonary aspergillosis and of Aspergillus bronchitis, and is part of the chronic pulmonary symptom complex the diagnostic criteria require.
Cough can be part of the asthma presentation.
Fever occurs among the nonspecific systemic manifestations, particularly in thoracic presentations.
Fever can be high and prolonged in adenovirus pneumonia.

Fever is the commonest clinical sign of acute invasive disease, recorded in 98% of one COVID-19-associated pulmonary aspergillosis cohort, and what makes it useful is not its presence but its refractoriness: the temperature stays above 38.5 degrees Celsius through broad-spectrum antibacterial therap
Fever is a very frequent manifestation of symptomatic babesiosis.
Dyspnea occurs with pulmonary mass and consolidation.
Dyspnea is a warning feature of severe pediatric adenovirus pneumonia.

Breathlessness belongs to the classic symptom triad of chronic pulmonary aspergillosis alongside prolonged cough and weight loss, although a 69-patient series counted it in only 7.2% of cases, so the triad describes the syndrome better than it predicts any individual patient. It is also part of the
Headache was recorded in 3/50 typical and 4/13 atypical registry cases with available data. It is nonspecific and does not by itself establish a causal neurologic mechanism.
Headache is a very frequent symptom in babesiosis.
Expiratory wheeze reflects lower-airway disease and can accompany acute bronchospasm.
Abdominal pain is a common presentation of gastrointestinal-site actinomycosis.
An extra-respiratory manifestation reported in the mixed N-ERD reaction spectrum; no individual-feature prevalence is inferred from the proportion with any extra-respiratory symptom.
